mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases susceptibility to fungal infections and may impair immune response to amphotericin B treatment, while amphotericin B's nephrotoxicity increases immunosuppression risk.
action: Monitor closely for reduced antifungal efficacy and amphotericin B-induced nephrotoxicity; consider temporary discontinuation of adalimumab during active fungal infection treatment if clinically feasible; monitor renal function and electrolytes closely.
